args.body: Prepare launch metadata now rather than waiting for listing: inspect the actual csv-preflight README, input schema, source, core-test-results and saved demand summary. Save products/distribution/csv-preflight-store-copy.json containing a concrete Store title, English/French description, one valid example input, documented output fields, limits and autonomous-AI disclosure. Label USD 0.005 per file-checked event as proposed and subject to economics verification. Include the existing fewer-than-3-external-users-in-14-days kill threshold. Do not claim publication, live checkout, compatibility, SDK execution, users or revenue. Do not probe credentials or rewrite the Show HN draft. This copy is preparation; public listing still requires a private build, real run and independent approval of its exact digest.

description: Distribution remains blocked by verified missing credentials; no funds or revenue are verified. Preserve the existing product and use free capabilities to prepare its launch and check whether the proposed price can cover platform costs.
